asset_registry.name: 厚樟树叶小船
asset_registry.appearance: 唯一一片深浅自然的厚樟树叶，细长椭圆，边缘均匀微微上卷，叶脉清楚；始终是一片叶子，不折叠成纸船。
asset_registry.first_state: pipi在溪边捡选，后带回家入陶盘

asset_registry.name: 粉红花瓣乘客
asset_registry.appearance: 单粒轻薄浅粉色花瓣，圆润细长、干燥；始终位于LEAF_01船舱中央，不变形、不复制。
states: 靠岸后仍干燥并留在原处

asset_registry.name: 浅口大陶盘
asset_registry.appearance: 宽沿、浅口、暖陶土色大圆盘，盛清水；外形大小、桌面位置和朝向一致。

asset_registry.name: 扁平鹅卵石码头标记
asset_registry.appearance: 一块小而扁的灰褐色圆滑鹅卵石，不带刻字、不发光。
states: 陶盘外桌沿对准叶船停靠点，之后不再移动

asset_registry.name: 木卧室固定陈设
asset_registry.appearance: 固定木墙、同一扇窗、木床、柔软浅米色枕头和暖黄色毛毯；不加入未在本集出现的玩偶。

geography.creek_flow: all creek shots water flows left to right
geography.porch_table: DISH_01 stable at center of low porch table; flowerpot stays left of table; warm window light remains behind.
geography.boat_docking: leaf stops against dish inner rim; PEbbLE_01 rests outside rim directly aligned

character_transitions: daytime outing creek pipi in day_v001
night bedroom pipi changes to sleep_v001 before entering; only pillow and yellow blanket are story-supported bed props.
causal_chain: return home and fill one shallow ceramic dish
place leaf on water and one dry pink petal in center
gentle breath makes leaf rotate half-turn
water calms; leaf follows gentle current to dish rim
pipi places one small flat pebble outside the dish rim directly aligned with the docking point; pebble is never placed in the water.
journey ends; pipi transitions to bedroom and rests
